verdict.rationale: Drata's public API v2 has list and read endpoints for core compliance objects: personnel, controls, risks, audits, policies, monitoring tests, devices and custom connections. That makes programmatic extraction of much of the data plausible. However, nothing documents a bulk 'export all data' feature, open export formats, or an offboarding and data-portability process. A user would have to piece together an export through many API calls. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or bulk data export, an explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) export statement, offboarding and data-portability documentation, coverage of evidence files and attachments, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a complete exit is possible.
